newsitem.title: USA: Stolt upbeat on specialty chemicals.
newsitem.headline: Stolt upbeat on specialty chemicals.

text.p: Stolt-Nielsen SA said Wednesday that while it sees a possible reduction in the commodity chemicals trade to the Asia Pacific area as new plants crop up in the region, it expects continued growth in demand for the transportation of specialty chemicals.

Specialty chemicals transportation makes up the bulk of its Stolt Parcel Tanker unit's business, the company said. It said that volumes shipped under contracts continue to be firm but there is less activity in the spot market, as traders of petrochemicals see reduced arbitrage opportunities and a strong U.S. economy hurts exports.

The company said that Stolt Tank Containers experienced pressure on freight rates in Europe and the Asia Pacific region. Shipments for the second quarter of 1997 were 32.2 percent ahead of the same period in 1996, it said.
Stolt Comex Seaway reported a net profit of $10.4 million in the second quarter compared with a net loss of $12.8 million for the prior year period, the company said.
